findings.title: NetworkPolicy blocks the connection to a Service
findings.cause: container web exits because its connection to Service db times out: NetworkPolicy egress-dns-only allows no egress traffic between them on port 8080, and a blocked connection is dropped, not refused; its log says: "wget: download timed out"; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container web exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 6 times
last lines of container web's log (run that exited)
evidence.detail:
Connecting to db (10.96.41.181:80)
wget: download timed out

evidence.what: NetworkPolicy egress-dns-only restricts the client's egress and no egress rule in the namespace allows app=web,pod-template-hash=6b85fb4bb8 pods to port 8080 of app=db,pod-template-hash=756d549855 pods

findings.fix: Add an egress rule to egress-dns-only (or another policy selecting the client pods) that allows pods with app=db on port 8080.
